header.title: Upload a health report
header.subtitle: Upload a PDF or a clear photo to strengthen the evidence behind your nutrition guidance.

hero.title: Upload first, then review OCR output
hero.body: This step does not replace your questionnaire answers. It adds key biomarkers so the later guidance is easier to explain and trust.

formatsLabel: Supports PDF / JPG / PNG, with a recommended file size under 10 MB

steps.title: Upload the original report
steps.body: Use a physical exam or lab result from the last 90 days when possible.

steps.title: System extracts biomarkers
steps.body: We identify key data first and then route you into manual confirmation.

steps.title: Confirm before it enters the report
steps.body: Low-confidence items stay flagged so you remain the final reviewer.

idleCard.title: Choose a file to get started
idleCard.body: A full frame, no occlusion, and sharp text will reduce follow-up confirmation work.

readyCard.title: Your file is ready
readyCard.body: Once the file looks right, start recognition and we will move you into the confirmation page automatically.

processingCard.title: Recognizing now
processingCard.body: We are extracting key biomarkers and shaping them into a review-ready result.

footerNote: Uploads are used only to explain nutrition guidance and never replace medical diagnosis.
